text:
Maya Singh: Heads-up: Brooklyn tech meetup next Wed night. Need final checklist for booth, speaking slot, swag, and lead flow. Can we triage quickly?
Theo Park: I'll handle speaking submission. Propose 10-min benchmark demo + 3 bullet takeaways.
Rita Gomez: Swag: suggest 250 tees, 200 stickers, 100 postcards. Stickers should have QR to form.
SwagBot: Draft PO RED-2026-301 created: tees(250), stickers(200), postcards(100). Est ship 2026-05-10.
Kofi Mensah: Logistics: load-in 16:30, table 6ft, 1 power outlet. I can pick up the kit day before.
Maya Singh: Lead form flow: QR -> email/company/role/check interests -> tag brooklyn_meetup -> auto-email events@redwood.com. If company size>50 route to AE queue.
Theo Park: Demo metrics to show: p50 110ms, p95 420ms, tokens/sec 260, cost $0.42/1k w/ caching. Will prepare 2 slides.
Rita Gomez: Design notes: tee front small logo, back small tagline "Inference that scales". Postcards: 3 bullets + QR. I'll share mocks by Mon 10:00.
SwagBot: Supplier notice: small sizes low. Recommend +30 smalls.
Maya Singh: Action items: Theo - slides + submitter bio; Rita - mockups + order smalls backup; Kofi - confirm pickup time.
Kofi Mensah: Confirmed pickup Fri 09:00. I'll bring surge strip and HDMI adapter.
Theo Park: Submitting talk now — snagged 19:30 demo slot.
Maya Singh: Great. Let's reconvene Tue 09:30 for final checks. :thumbsup:
